task: Repair trusted one-minute bar completeness and partition integrity
method: Make completed-bar ingestion session-aware and idempotent across prior trading days, partition rows by their actual market date, add completeness audit/backfill tooling and regression tests, repair existing misplaced/missing August bars only from verified provider data, then deploy and verify.
owner_request: Audit found August 28 missing 27 closing bars and prior-session bars physically written into later trading-day partitions; silent gaps make backtests untrustworthy.
before_state: Global bar history is complete for Aug 24-27, Aug 28 has 363/390 RTH minutes, and Aug 31 has 385/390 at audit time. Collector fetches one calendar day and writes all returned rows under capture-day partition, so weekday tails can land in next-day partitions and Friday tails are skipped after a weekend.
reason: Audit found August 28 missing 27 closing bars and prior-session bars physically written into later trading-day partitions; silent gaps make backtests untrustworthy.
intended_scope: Shared market_data collector/store and strategy-neutral audit/backfill tests/tooling; existing verified bar data repair. No trader strategy, scoreboard, Discord, updater, or frozen supervisor changes.
expected_effects: Each bar is stored under its own Central-time trading date, prior trading sessions are automatically audited/backfilled, duplicates remain harmless, manifests expose completeness, and backtests can reject incomplete sessions.
required_tests: Unit tests for per-row partitioning, weekend prior-session backfill, deduplication, 390-minute completeness/gap reporting, no-lookahead/as-of behavior; focused and full CI; post-deploy live audit of Aug 24 onward.
risks: Historical provider results may be unavailable or incomplete; never fabricate bars, label unresolved gaps explicitly, preserve append-only source records, and avoid destructive rewrites until verified replacement data exists.
next_safe_action_if_interrupted: Commit and PR the code; pass CI; merge and deploy through frozen updater; run owner-authorized audit_bar_history --apply for Aug 24-31 using runtime credentials; verify 390/390 sessions or explicitly disclose provider-unrecoverable gaps; verify information engine and all traders remain healthy.

Focused 65 tests and full repository suite pass. Existing data not yet modified.
